instruction: What is the total cost of my electricity bills for this year? The bills are in "~/bills/" directory of my file system.
notes: Pure information-retrieval task: no database changes, only the numeric answer matters. The agent logs into file_system (username = supervisor email from show_profile, password from show_account_passwords), learns the current year via phone.get_current_date_and_time, lists ~/bills/electricity, reads every bill file of the current year and sums the 'Total Amount' values. Because STRIPS cannot sum, the total is an answer object whose knowledge is implied by having read all this-year bills: files form a read chain (next-entry) anchored at the directory listing, so (inspected last-bill) structurally implies all bills were read, and complete-task requires it plus current-date-known. The number of this-year bill files is only known after show_directory; the problem instantiates four (Jan-Apr 2023, given current date 2023-05-18) - adjust the file objects and chain links to match the actual listing. App constants are hyphenated (file-system).
